The '''''Crusher''-class starfighter''' was a two-man [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] equipped with formidable cannons used by two [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunters]] working for the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
